sources.title: NIST SP 800-207: Zero Trust Architecture
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: CISA 零信任成熟度：用證據追蹤五大支柱
related.titleEn: CISA zero-trust maturity: evidence across five pillars
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：兩組總數與集合皆吻合；角色撤銷和裝置降級皆被拒絕，控制面不可用時的行為有明確紀錄。 交付信任邊界圖、八列政策測試、100筆去識別化判定表與回復條件。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Both sets and totals reconcile; revoked roles and degraded devices are denied, and control-plane failure behavior is documented. Deliver the boundary diagram, eight policy tests, 100 pseudonymous decision rows and rollback conditions.
related.difference: 為五大支柱各設五項可驗證需求；將政策文件、實際設定、測試結果分欄，缺少測試的控制保持未驗證。
related.differenceEn: Define five testable requirements per pillar; separate policy text, implemented configuration and test results, leaving untested controls unverified.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 只要必要條件之一不成立便拒絕；聯集計數需扣除同時失敗者，不能把重複拒絕算成額外使用者。 合成的100次請求皆在有效時段；12次角色不符、8次裝置不符，其中3次同時不符。 拒絕12+8−3=17次，允許100−17=83次；裝置不符改15、重疊改5時，允許78次。
證據覆蓋率=有完整且未過期證據的需求數/固定需求總數；成熟度等級是序位，不能直接平均成安全分數。 教學清單25項；17項有設定快照、負責人與最近一次測試，8項缺證據。 覆蓋17/25×100=68%；補齊4項後21/25×100=84%，仍有4項未驗證。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Deny when any required condition fails; union counts subtract overlapping failures rather than treating duplicate denials as additional people. In 100 synthetic in-window requests, 12 fail role, 8 fail device posture, and 3 fail both. Deny 12+8−3=17 and allow 83; with 15 device failures and overlap 5, allow 78.

Evidence coverage is complete, fresh evidence divided by a fixed requirement count; maturity categories are ordinal, not numbers to average into a security score. A teaching checklist has 25 requirements; 17 have a configuration snapshot, owner and recent test, while 8 lack evidence. Coverage is 17/25×100=68%; completing 4 more yields 21/25×100=84%, with 4 unverified.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: X.509 信任鏈：名稱限制與有效期交集
related.titleEn: X.509 paths: name constraints and validity intersections
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：兩組總數與集合皆吻合；角色撤銷和裝置降級皆被拒絕，控制面不可用時的行為有明確紀錄。 交付信任邊界圖、八列政策測試、100筆去識別化判定表與回復條件。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Both sets and totals reconcile; revoked roles and degraded devices are denied, and control-plane failure behavior is documented. Deliver the boundary diagram, eight policy tests, 100 pseudonymous decision rows and rollback conditions.
related.difference: 為虛構校園CA畫出根、簽發CA與服務憑證；逐層標示basicConstraints、keyUsage、名稱限制與用途，不把鏈存在當驗證成功。
related.differenceEn: Draw a fictional campus root, issuing CA and service certificate; annotate basicConstraints, keyUsage, name constraints and purpose at each layer without treating chain presence as validation success.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 只要必要條件之一不成立便拒絕；聯集計數需扣除同時失敗者，不能把重複拒絕算成額外使用者。 合成的100次請求皆在有效時段；12次角色不符、8次裝置不符，其中3次同時不符。 拒絕12+8−3=17次，允許100−17=83次；裝置不符改15、重疊改5時，允許78次。
教學時間交集取max(notBefore)到min(notAfter)，但名稱、用途、簽章與可信錨仍須獨立通過。 葉憑證有效日10至90，簽發CA有效日0至100；信任錨已由另一步驗證，本題採半開區間。 交集長度min(90,100)−max(10,0)=80日；葉憑證終日改70時為60日。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Deny when any required condition fails; union counts subtract overlapping failures rather than treating duplicate denials as additional people. In 100 synthetic in-window requests, 12 fail role, 8 fail device posture, and 3 fail both. Deny 12+8−3=17 and allow 83; with 15 device failures and overlap 5, allow 78.

The teaching validity intersection runs from max(notBefore) to min(notAfter); names, purpose, signatures and trust anchors still require separate checks. Leaf validity is days 10–90 and issuing-CA validity 0–100; the trust anchor is established separately and intervals are half-open for this exercise. Intersection length is min(90,100)−max(10,0)=80 days; changing leaf end to 70 gives 60 days.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
